title: Equality-pair repair map
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $w$ be a Boolean string on $2n$ coordinates. Identify each coordinate with a pair $(i,b)\in\mathrm{Fin}(n)\times\mathrm{Fin}(2)$ using the standard product indexing, and write $e(i,b)$ for its equality-pair address. The repaired string assigns to every coordinate $(i,b)$ the value of $w$ at $e(i,0)$.
